notes.notes:
Dear users:

notes.title: [Updated on November 8] Name Change of Japanese Version of Paper Bride 3
notes.notes:
Dear paper fans:
In order to facilitate Japanese paper fans to better understand the content of the story, we have optimized the translation of the game name and updated it.
It is now officially renamed 紙装束3 愛の咎, thank you for your support!
If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us via discord: https://discord.gg/kPNcQB4FdC
